method: Read-only per-frame mask replay using capture-time interpolated pose. Local lidar reproduces its road ROI and existing union-lane mask; route reproduces obstacle_points, applies the new lane mask, then runs existing boundary removal, matching production order; the original route pipeline applies only boundary removal; main lidar starts at its recorded used-point cloud (so ground/IMU segmentation is not rerun). Recorded obstacle centers are filtered independently without rerunning tracker state. Outside S12 arrays are compared exactly.
limitations: Offline recorded-data analysis only; no live ROS nodes or vehicle commands were used, and this is not real-vehicle driving validation.
This verifies spatial filtering per recorded frame, not vehicle closed-loop behavior or complete post-change tracking histories.
Missing bracketing poses (>0.15 s gaps or outside recorded range) are skipped and counted.
Route and local poses are interpolated from their own recorded pose topics; callback arrival ordering is not reproduced.
